title: Ecma International TC39-relevant MDN issues
description: Issue filed on MDN Web Docs related to pages attached to technologies developed by Ecma International TC39

items.content_html:
MDN URL

https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/JSON

What specific section or headline is this issue about?

Full JSON grammar

What information was incorrect, unhelpful, or incomplete?

The ABNF starts with the following line:

JSON-text = object / array

which corresponds to the ABNF described in RFC 4627

What did you expect to see?

The ABNF should start with the following line:

JSON-text = ws value ws

which corresponds to the ABNF described in RFC 8259

Do you have any supporting links, references, or citations?

RFC 4627: https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc4627
RFC 8259: https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8259
RFC 7158: https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7158

Do you have anything more you want to share?

Additionally, the section "Appendix A. Changes from RFC 4627" of RFC 7158 describes the following change:

o Changed the definition of "JSON text" so that it can be any JSON value, removing the constraint that it be an object or array.
items.title: [ecmascript] ABNF for JSON is using the obsoleted RFC 4627

MDN URL

https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Statements/for-await...of

What specific section or headline is this issue about?

From Note: until but not including Specification.

What information was incorrect, unhelpful, or incomplete?

It seems at least modern Chrome does correctly call finally in the specified circumstances.

Assuming this is the case in all modern browsers and is perhaps even specified as such,
the corresponding content should be removed.

What did you expect to see?

No warning about an obsolete issue, assuming it actually is.

Do you have any supporting links, references, or citations?

Someone should check what the relevant spec says, I'm too busy, sorry.

No response
